Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain

Record Class KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPaymentCommand

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain.KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPaymentCommand
Record Components:
userId - payment owner
walletId - source wallet identifier
walletName - source wallet name for provider context
destinationAddress - recipient Bitcoin address
amountSats - amount to send in satoshis
maxFeeSats - maximum permitted fee in satoshis
description - payment memo or audit description
idempotencyKey - stable caller retry key
authorizationProof - proof accepted by the payment authorization boundary
feeRateSatsPerVbyte - explicit fee tier in sat/vB, preferred when positive
confirmationTarget - block target used when estimating fee without an explicit rate
Enclosing interface:
KfeOnchainPaymentGateway
public static record KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPaymentCommand(Long userId, Long walletId, String walletName, String destinationAddress, long amountSats, long maxFeeSats, String description, String idempotencyKey, String authorizationProof, Long feeRateSatsPerVbyte, Integer confirmationTarget) extends Record
Authorized on-chain payment request, including both explicit fee rate and confirmation target.
